data.text/markdown:
Gluon ghost subtraction

Browse all notebooks · Physical polarization calculation Generate ||(b\bar b\to gg||) with the bottom mass retained and use covariant gluon polarization sums. These include unphysical states. Generate both ghost–antighost orderings separately and subtract their squared amplitudes to recover the physical result. All three gluon diagrams and their interference are included. Shared Particle.color_sum and Particle.spin_sum provide the initial averages and completeness tensors; Idenso and Spenso perform the algebra. Ghosts carry color but have no external polarization wavefunctions. The checks compare each ghost contribution and the final massive ||(SU(N_c)||) result with FeynCalc, then verify the massless ||(SU(3)||) limit and exchange of the two final gluons. External spins are four-dimensional and ||(T_R=1/2||). The symbolic calculation takes a few minutes.
